text:
Anna: FYI — opal-v2 int8 onboarding looks off. BLEU drops ~3.8 on ja/zh and arabic/hebrew show bracket mirroring + punctuation attach issues. Ran the nightly multilingual translate suite and grabbed a few samples: https://bench.redwood/runs/452

Mei: Can you paste a minimal repro and tokenization diff? Wondering if this is an int8 kernel change or tokenizer preproc vocab mismatch.

Anna: repro below:
```
python tools/eval_multilang.py --model opal-v2-int8 --suite translate --langs ja,zh,ar,he --batch 64 --seed 42
# run id: 2026-03-20_opal_v2_int8
```
Sample (input -> model output):
- ja: "私は学生です。" -> "私 は 学生 です。"  (notice extra spaces/tokens)
- zh: "他去学校。" -> "他 去 学校"  (missing final punct attach)
- ar: "(مرحبا)" -> "(مرحبا)" but brackets get mirrored/flipped in downstream detok

Sanjay: quick tokenization dump on a failing case shows an extra ZWSP-style token on the int8 path. token ids differ: 
```
expected tokens: [3201, 125, 9042, 5]
opal-v2-int8:    [3201, 125, 0, 9042, 5]
```
That extra 0 maps to a softspace/zwsp sentinel. Could be tokenizer preproc inserting it or kernel padding messing KV alignment.

Mei: thanks — can you run a focused bisect: kernel int8 v1 vs v2, and tokenizer build v-tokenizer-2026-03 vs v-tokenizer-2026-02 on a 200-example ja/zh/ar slice? I queued a job: https://ci.redwood/bisect/987

ops-bot: Canary job started: canary-987 on ded-int8-pool (3 nodes). Logs: https://ci.redwood/canary/987/logs

Anna: assigning @Sanjay to triage. If bisect points to kernel, we'll fallback to q4 kernel for the onboarding rollout until we have a fix. :thumbsup:

Sanjay: I'll run the bisect today and post the minimal failing snippet + tokenizer diffs. If it's tokenizer, I'll prepare a small preproc hotfix to normalize fullwidth punctuation and ZWSP handling.

Mei: please keep BLEU deltas per-locale (ja/zh/ar/he) — increase ja/zh sample size by 3x in the suite to reduce noise while we root-cause.

Anna: attaching one minimal failing pair for quick triage:
Input: "今日は、学校へ行きます。"
Expected detok: "今日は、学校へ行きます。"
opal-v2-int8 detok: "今日は 、 学校 へ 行きます 。"

Sanjay: noted. will follow up with bisect results and a short PR if tokenizer fix is needed.
